title: Quantum wreath products and Yang-Baxter equations
summary: We extend the setup of Lai-Nakano-Xiang's quantum wreath product algebras to symmetric monoidal categories and deformed braid relations. Under some mild assumptions, we drastically simplify the criterion for such algebras to have PBW basis; curiously, the new criterion is phrased in terms of associative and quantum Yang-Baxter equations. As an application, we clean up some basis results in the existing literature, and propose a certain generalization of quiver Hecke algebras.
